items.name: Alchemist's Fire (Moderate)
items.description:
Activate A Strike

Alchemist's fire is a combination of volatile liquids that ignite when exposed to air. Alchemist's fire deals 2d8 fire damage, 2 persistent fire damage, and 2 fire splash damage. You gain a +1 item bonus to attack rolls.

items.name: +1 Striking Rod of Wonder
items.description:
This hard but flexible longsword-length piece of wood looks more like a pole than a weapon, but can be deadly in the right hands. While generally not used for combat outside of Song'o culture, some halflings have become so proficient as to make it just as effective as a blade in a fight. Many halflings will even sing to maintain a certain tempo and rhythm during combat. It deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage. A fighting stick is a martial one-handed melee weapon in the club weapon group.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Rod of Wonder]

items.name: Studded Leather Armor
items.description: This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

items.name: Thieves' Tools (Infiltrator)
items.description:
You need thieves' tools to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Pick a Lock]{Pick Locks} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Disable a Device]{Disable Devices} (of some types) using the Thievery skill. Infiltrator thieves' tools add a +1 item bonus to checks to Pick Locks and Disable Devices.

If your thieves' tools are broken, you can repair them by replacing the lock picks with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Thieves' Toolkit (Infiltrator Picks)]{Replacement Picks} appropriate to your tools; this doesn't require using the Repair action. If you wear your thieves' tools, you can draw and replace them as part of the action that uses them.

defensiveAbilities.name: Halfling Luck
defensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger Thiarvo fails a skill check or a saving throw

Effect Thiarvo rerolls the triggering check and must use the new result.

offensiveAbilities.name: Fighting Rod
offensiveAbilities.description: Thiarvo's Rod of Wonder is supple wood and can be used as a Fighting Stick. It can be enchanted with fundamental runes but not property runes, and it's currently enchanted with the Weapon Potency (+1) and Striking runes.

offensiveAbilities.name: Lethal Fighter
offensiveAbilities.description: Thiarvo can make lethal attacks using weapons with the nonlethal trait without taking the usual -2 penalty. His attacks with weapons with the nonlethal trait deal an additional 2d8 precision damage, whether he's making nonlethal attacks or lethal attacks with them. This damage is included in his melee entry.

offensiveAbilities.name: Slippery Halfling
offensiveAbilities.description: Thiarvo ignores difficult terrain from trees, foliage, rubble, and undergrowth.
